newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta bank to offer low interest loans.
newsitem.headline: Malta bank to offer low interest loans.

text.p: Malta's Bank of Valletta said it will offer farmers and fishermen loans at up to three-percent interest to stimulate investment.
Bank chairman John C. Grech said the ministry of agriculture and fisheries would subsidize interest rate.

The loans, of up to Lm3,000 ($7,800), will be repayable in monthly installments over five years and used for agricultural machinery and fishing equipments investments. The interest rate will be two percent per annum on a secured basis and three percent per annum on an unsecured basis.
